why: The shaft's hatch in the near hall's floor built of iron bars instead of a closed iron trapdoor. Bars laid flat are posts two sixteenths wide, and the server joins them with arms two sixteenths wide; a player-wide body drops between them, and the walk model reads a floor from the blocks' collision footprints, not from whether the cells hold a block. So the hatch is no floor: a body stepping onto it falls into the undercroft before the beat that opens it, and the proof that every place a body can get into has a way back out names the fall. It declares no unit: the surface is the bar's block, and what must not compile is a floor a body falls through.
